page.title: Rental requests
page.subtitle: Your shop's request inbox: see which vehicle a guest asked for, when they need it, then approve or decline right here.

customer.heading: Customer
customer.noProfile: Not in your customer book yet

schedule.heading: Rental request
schedule.pickupWishHint: The exact pickup time is finalized when you approve.
schedule.deliveryFeeHint: The delivery fee is set on the booking once you and the guest agree.

actions.messageUnavailable: This guest requested by phone and has no XePrime account — call them or reach out on Zalo instead.

approve.title: Approve and create the booking?
approve.effect: Approving creates a booking and RESERVES this vehicle's schedule for the period below. Pricing follows your active policy.
approve.deliveryNote: This request asks for delivery. The booking starts with a 0₫ delivery fee — update it on the booking once you agree with the guest.
approve.scheduleConflict: The vehicle is already booked for this period — pick another pickup time or reject the request.

longTerm.title: Approve long-term rental request
longTerm.legacyPackageHint: This request was submitted before packages existed, so it carries none. Pick the package you agreed with the guest — the system deliberately does not infer one from the old date range.
longTerm.pickupPlaceholder: Choose the pickup date and time
longTerm.pickupHint: You can only pick within what the guest asked for. For any other date, reject the request and agree on a new one with them.
longTerm.returnHint: The booking lasts exactly as long as the package the guest bought — it cannot be edited by hand.
longTerm.quoteUnavailable: Could not load the package price — check this vehicle's long-term pricing before approving.
longTerm.wishLegacy: Legacy request — the guest did not state a preference

reject.title: Reject rental request
reject.reasonLabel: Reason for rejection (sent to the guest)
reject.reasonPlaceholder: Briefly explain why you cannot take this request
reject.reasonRequired: Enter a reason so the guest knows why the request was rejected
reject.reasonHint: The guest reads this in their notification, so write enough for them to know what to do next.

presets.scheduleUnavailable: We cannot accommodate the requested schedule.
presets.requirementsUnsuitable: The rental requirements do not fit our shop's policy.
